purpose: One row per invite target. Seatbook sends targets in; Clay enriches them and posts results back. Clay does enrichment only; route classification, scoring, caps and drafts happen in Seatbook.

trigger.sent_by: Seatbook API route /api/clay/enqueue (Vercel Function), one request per target
trigger.notes: The webhook only adds a row; enrichment runs asynchronously. Results come back through the HTTP API column below, not in the webhook response.

columns.name: work_history (Enrich person)
columns.provider: Clay person enrichment (any provider in Clay's waterfall)
columns.used_for: Tenure-overlap checks for the existing-customer and current-attendee routes

columns.name: warm_intro_paths (The Swarm)
columns.provider: The Swarm — 'Find warm intros to person' action

sources.shared_company: text (employer or organisation; absent for linkedin_connection)
sources.closeness: same_team | reporting_line | same_company (added in Clay, work_overlap only)
sources.detail: text (added in Clay; shown under the line as context)

columns.used_for: Candidate paths through customers, attendees and Vercel employees. The Swarm's response, trimmed to the fields Seatbook reads (no IDs, scores or pagination).

columns.name: tech_stack (Clay tech enrichment)
columns.provider: Technographics provider available in Clay (e.g. BuiltWith)
columns.used_for: Company-level backup for the 'already uses Vercel / Next.js' signal when product data is missing

columns.name: news_signal (Claygent)
columns.prompt: Find one recent (last 6 months) public announcement by {{company_name}} about AI agents, AI shopping/customer assistants, internal AI tools, platform engineering or developer productivity. Return one sentence and the source URL, or empty.
columns.used_for: 'Why now' signal and theme fit (apps & agents vs software factory)

columns.name: hiring_signal (Claygent)
columns.prompt: From {{company_name}}'s careers page, summarize open roles in platform engineering, frontend platform, developer productivity or AI tooling in one line. Return empty if none.

columns.name: send_to_seatbook (HTTP API)
columns.run_condition: Only run when work_history and warm_intro_paths have finished
columns.used_for: Seatbook stores the enrichment, then rebuilds that target's invite plan
